summary: Danaher Corporation filed a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a $3.0 billion multi-tranche senior notes offering, comprising $500M floating rate notes due 2028 and $750M, $750M, and $1.0B fixed-rate notes due 2030, 2034, and 2038 respectively. Proceeds will fund a portion of the cash consideration for the proposed acquisition of Masimo Corporation. The offering is not conditioned on closing the acquisition; if the merger is not consummated by November 16, 2026 (Outside Date), the fixed-rate notes are subject to special mandatory redemption at 101% of principal plus accrued interest. The notes are unsecured, rank equally with other unsecured senior debt, and are subordinate to secured debt. Application will be made to list on NYSE. Watch for completion of the Masimo acquisition or triggering of the special mandatory redemption.
